name: Basil-Balsamic Drumsticks with Broccoli, Bell Pepper & Sweet Potato

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F). Arrange racks in the upper, middle, and lower positions.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 crowns broccoli
3 yellow bell peppers
0.68 kg sweet potato

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large baking dish.
Juice lemons into the baking dish with the garlic; add vinegar, oil, and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup balsamic vinegar
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp basil, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Add to the baking dish with the marinade and turn to coat.
Place chicken on the upper rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, turning once, until cooked through, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; divide between two large baking sheet pans.
Peel, trim, and small dice sweet potatoes; add to the baking sheets with the broccoli.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into ½-inch thick strips; add to the baking sheets. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place veggies on the lower racks of the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until lightly charred and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide drumsticks and veggies between plates; drizzle with sauce from the baking dish and enjoy!
